settings_edit_prompt: Edit the supplied GuildStock Settings UI concept. Remove the entire left sidebar, including all navigation entries, profession labels, icons, vertical border and divider. Expand the Settings content pane leftwards to occupy the entire interior width below the top header. Keep comfortable equal left/right margins and make its three existing groups span the available width. Keep every setting, label, checkbox state, dropdown, slider and synchronization description exactly as in the original. Keep the top GuildStock header, neutral crate emblem, three top tabs with Ajustes active, close button, bottom status footer and small concept caption. Preserve the dark modern WoW aesthetic, restrained gold border, typography, aspect ratio and visual quality. There must be no sidebar or empty reserved sidebar space; just one full-width Settings content area. Do not add any controls, bank references, manual sync or publication functions. Spanish text remains unchanged.
reference: material-browser.png (visual style only; earlier functionality superseded)

screens.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished Spanish UI concept screen for the WoW Forever addon GuildStock. Reference image 1 is a visual style and layout reference ONLY, not content to preserve: keep its dark charcoal surfaces, thin muted gold frame, cream typography, small WoW item icons, clean modern fantasy appearance. Wide 1600x1000 image, straight-on single addon window on charcoal backdrop. Improve density slightly: small elegant icons, plenty of horizontal space for table. Top title "GuildStock", subtitle "Materiales de hermandad", neutral crate emblem (no faction logo), tabs "Materiales", "Mi inventario", "Ajustes", close X. IMPORTANT NEW RULES: only bags, absolutely NO bank column, bank text or bank settings; no publication, offering, pause-sharing, publish, refresh or manual-sync controls anywhere. Synchronization is automatic. Footer green indicator and exact text "Sincronización automática de hermandad". Outside window tiny caption "Concepto visual · Datos de ejemplo". Beautiful legible UI, implementable using standard WoW addon frames. Fictional players and illustrative materials. Screen: ALL MATERIALS browser. "Materiales" top tab active. Left navigation "Para mis profesiones", "Todos los materiales" SELECTED in gold, "Favoritos"; below separator heading "PROFESIONES", options "Alquimia", "Herrería", "Ingeniería", "Sastrería", "Cocina". Middle material list with search "Buscar material...", heading "Todos los materiales", category dropdown "Todas las profesiones". Rows with item icon and small outline favorite stars: "Barra de cobre" SELECTED; "Flor de paz"; "Mineral de cobre"; "Paño de lino"; "Piedra burda"; "Polvo extraño". Right wider detail panel heading "Barra de cobre" with modest item icon, subtitle "Herrería · Ingeniería", favorite outline star upper-right. The selected-material detail table must have exactly FOUR columns, spelled "Jugador", "Bolsas", "Última conexión", "Susurrar". Each player row has its OWN rectangular "Susurrar" button aligned in the rightmost column. Online rows show green presence dot AND text "En línea", their buttons have warm gold outlines and cream text. Offline rows are muted, display an age in Última conexión, and their Susurrar buttons are clearly DISABLED dark gray with muted gray text, no gold outline. No separate shared whisper button below the table. Below table a small note "Cantidades según la última sincronización." and a second line "Desconectados: último recuento conocido." Exactly four table rows: "Aldren | 40 | En línea | Susurrar", "Mirel | 18 | En línea | Susurrar", "Brannoc | 25 | Hace 2 h | Susurrar" disabled, "Elowen | 10 | Hace 2 días | Susurrar" disabled. Make the four column headers and all per-row buttons crisp and fully readable. The sidebar, materials list and wide player table are all clearly separate columns.
